item.title: Leeuwin Metals Commences Phase 2 Drilling at Marda Gold Project - Resources Roadhouse
item.description: THE DRILL SERGEANT: Leeuwin Metals (ASX: LM1) has commenced a Phase 2 reverse circulation (RC) drilling program at the company’s 100 per cent-owned Marda gold project in Western Australia. Leeuwin Metals has kicked off the drilling at the project’s Marda Central prospect designed to extend high-grade mineralisation identified in its earlier Phase 1 drilling campaign.
